# Functions 
```{r}
# Functions limits and breaks
fun_breaks <- function(x) {
  if (max(x) > 2) {
    if (((ceiling(max(x)) - floor(min(x))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)), length.out = 3)
    } else {
      seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)+1), length.out = 3)
    }
  } else {
    if (((ceiling(max(x*10)) - floor(min(x*10))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      seq(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)), length.out = 3)/10
    } else {
      seq(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)+1), length.out = 3)/10
    }
  }
}
fun_limits <- function(x) {
  if (max(x) > 2) {
    if (((ceiling(max(x)) - floor(min(x))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      c(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)))
    } else {
      c(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)+1))
    }
  }  else {
    if (((ceiling(max(x*10)) - floor(min(x*10))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      c(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)))/10
    } else {
      c(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)+1))/10
    }
  }
}
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
# selpat_l <- c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtp", "multi_pertu", "multi_men")
# gppat <- "1"
selpat_l <- c("multi_pn", "multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv")
gppat <- "2"

# Read in the data 
dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  if(x %in% c("varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "multi_mmr")) {vac <- "v1"
  } else {vac <- "vl"}
  dat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/data_brms_{x}_{vac}_s08.rds"))
  if(x %in% c("multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv")) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      relocate(imm_val_s1_anti_polio_1, imm_val_s1_anti_polio_2, imm_val_s1_anti_polio_3)
  }
  return(dat)
  }, simplify = FALSE)

datlong_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  dat_l[[x]] %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(!c(starts_with("censored"), starts_with("imm_val_s0"))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("imm_val_s1"), names_to = "imm_name", values_to = "imm_val_s1",
                 cols_vary = "slowest") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "imm_val_s1_"))}, 
  simplify = FALSE)

# Types of clustering 
clu_name <- "reg_3"
clu_name_l <- c(2, 3, 4, 6) 
names(clu_name_l) <- c("reg_2b", "reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6a")

# Plot all
lapply(names(clu_name_l), function(clu_name) {
  pl <- bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
    mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l)) %>%
    rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
    mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
    group_by(pathogen, vac_week_v1, clu, imm_name) %>%
    summarise(mean_imm = mean(imm_val_s1),
              sd_imm = sd(imm_val_s1),
              tot = n(),
              tot_s = length(unique(study))) %>%
    # ungroup() %>%
    # group_by(pathogen, clu, imm_name) %>%
    # mutate(mean_overall = mean(mean_imm)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = log(mean_imm), size = tot)) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) + 
    geom_point(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = -Inf), size = 4, shape = "|") +
    scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
    scale_size_continuous("Individuals", breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + 
    facet_grid(pathogen + imm_name~clu, scales = "free") + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") 
  ggsave(pl, file = glue("outputs/figures/all_datamvn{gppat}_{clu_name}.pdf"),
         height = 15, width = clu_name_l[clu_name]*1.5 + 2)
  return(pl)
  })
#4.5*15
```

# Read models for a single clustering method
```{r}
# Read models
# mod_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
#   if(x %in% c("varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "multi_mmr")) {vac <- "v1"
#   } else {vac <- "vl"}
#   readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/bm{vac}_s08_{x}_csi_{clu_name}_gauss.rds"))}, simplify = FALSE)

# Obtain the conditional effects 
ce_dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  ce_dat <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/ce_dat_{x}.rds"), {
  lapply(conditional_effects(mod_l[[x]], resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1:{clu_name}")),
          as.data.frame) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=\\.immvals1anti).+?(?=_pi)")) %>%
    mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
    mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
    select(imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu, estimate__, lower__, upper__) %>%
    left_join(dat_l[[x]] %>%
                mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
                distinct(vac_week_v1, pi_vac_week_v1)) %>%
    left_join(dat_l[[x]] %>%
                rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
                mutate(clu = as.character(clu),
                       pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
                group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
                summarise(tot = n())) %>%
    mutate(estimate__ = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = estimate__),
           lower__ = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = lower__),
           upper__ = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = upper__))
  })
  return(ce_dat)
    }, simplify = FALSE)

# Plot conditional effects 
pl_ce <- bind_rows(ce_dat_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l)) %>%
  filter(clu == clu_name_val) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = log(estimate__))) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = log(lower__), ymax = log(upper__)), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = "white", fill = "red") + 
  geom_line(color = "red") + 
  scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
  facet_grid(pathogen+imm_name~"Conditional \n effect on \n ab titers (log)", scales = "free") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank())
```

# Make predictions 
```{r}
# Predictions for the single values 
pred_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  pred_dat <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/pred_dat_{x}.rds"), {
  pred <- predict(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 100, robust = TRUE) %>%
    apply(3, as.data.frame) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "anti(.*)"))
  epred <- fitted(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 100, robust = TRUE) %>%
    apply(3, as.data.frame) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "anti(.*)"))
  datlong_l[[x]] %>%
    rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
    mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
    select(imm_name, vac_week_v1, imm_val_s1, clu, study) %>%
    mutate(pred_m = pred$Estimate,
           pred_q2.5 = pred$Q2.5,
           pred_q97.5 = pred$Q97.5,
           imm_name_pred = pred$imm_name,
           epred_m = epred$Estimate,
           epred_q2.5 = epred$Q2.5,
           epred_q97.5 = epred$Q97.5,
           imm_name_epred = epred$imm_name)
  })
  return(pred_dat)
}, simplify = FALSE)

lapply(pred_l, function(x) distinct(x, imm_name, imm_name_pred, imm_name_epred))

# Plot observations vs predictions 
pl_pred <- bind_rows(pred_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l)) %>%
  filter(clu == clu_name_val) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = log(pred_m), x = log(imm_val_s1))) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.01, color = "red") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = log(pred_q2.5), ymax = log(pred_q97.5)),
                 size = 1, alpha = 0.01, color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous("Observed \n Ab titers (log)", breaks = fun_breaks, limits = fun_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Predicted Ab titers (log)", breaks = fun_breaks, limits = fun_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  facet_grid(pathogen+imm_name~"Model fit: \n Predicted \n ab titers (log)", scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.y.right = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# Predictions of the mean per week 
# Predictions for the single values 
pred_sum_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  pred_sum_dat <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/pred_sum_dat_{x}.rds"), {
    pred <- posterior_predict(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 10) %>%
      apply(3, as.data.frame) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name_pred") %>%
      mutate(imm_name_pred = str_extract(imm_name_pred, "anti(.*)")) %>%
      group_by(imm_name_pred) %>%
      mutate(draw = row_number()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("V")) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = draw, values_from = value, names_prefix = "draw_") %>%
      bind_cols(datlong_l[[x]] %>%
        rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%  
        select(imm_name, vac_week_v1, imm_val_s1, clu)) %>%
      rename(vid = name) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("draw_"))) %>%
      group_by(imm_name, imm_name_pred, name, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(mean_pred = mean(value),
               sd_pred = sd(value),
               mean_imm = mean(imm_val_s1),
               sd_imm = sd(imm_val_s1),
               tot = n())
    epred <- posterior_epred(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 10) %>%
      apply(3, as.data.frame) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name_epred") %>%
      mutate(imm_name_epred = str_extract(imm_name_epred, "anti(.*)")) %>%
      group_by(imm_name_epred) %>%
      mutate(draw = row_number()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("V")) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = draw, values_from = value, names_prefix = "draw_") %>%
      bind_cols(datlong_l[[x]] %>%
        rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%  
        select(imm_name, vac_week_v1, imm_val_s1, clu)) %>%
      rename(vid = name) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("draw_"))) %>%
      group_by(imm_name, imm_name_epred, name, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(mean_epred = mean(value),
                sd_epred = sd(value),
                mean_imm = mean(imm_val_s1),
                sd_imm = sd(imm_val_s1),
                tot = n()) 
    
    all <- left_join(pred, epred) %>%
      rename(draw = name) %>%
      select(imm_name, draw, vac_week_v1, clu, mean_imm, sd_imm, tot, 
             mean_pred, imm_name_pred, sd_pred, imm_name_pred,
             mean_epred, sd_epred, imm_name_epred)
    return(all)
  })
  return(pred_sum_dat)
}, simplify = FALSE)

pl_pred_sum <- bind_rows(pred_sum_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pathogen, imm_name, vac_week_v1, clu, mean_imm, sd_imm, tot) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred_m = mean(mean_pred),
            mean_pred_q2.5 = quantile(mean_pred, probs = 0.025), 
            mean_pred_q97.5 = quantile(mean_pred, probs = 0.975),
            mean_epred_m = mean(mean_epred),
            mean_epred_q2.5 = quantile(mean_epred, probs = 0.025), 
            mean_epred_q97.5 = quantile(mean_epred, probs = 0.975)) %>%
  filter(clu == clu_name_val) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = log(mean_imm), size = tot)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = log(mean_epred_m)), size = 1, color = "red", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = log(mean_epred_q2.5), ymax = log(mean_epred_q97.5)), color = "red", alpha = 0.3,
                 size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) +
  scale_size_continuous("Individuals", breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 150, 200)) +
  facet_grid(pathogen+imm_name~"Predicted \n ab titers (log) \n summarized \n (per week)", scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.y.right = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())
```
